This is a PE32+ x86-64 console executable with 19 sections. Interesting sections with names like /4, /19, /31, /45, /57, /70, /81, /97, /113 — these look like they could be overlay or appended data sections. The /19 section is quite large (0xb10e bytes ~ 45KB) with entropy 5.90.

Imports include:
- CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Thread32First, Thread32Next — thread enumeration
- OpenThread, SuspendThread — thread manipulation
- VirtualProtect, VirtualQuery — memory manipulation
- GetProcAddress, GetModuleHandleA
- SetUnhandledExceptionFilter — could be anti-debug
- Sleep

This looks like it might be a process hollowing or thread injection sample. Let me look at the strings and disassembly.
